overlap.needed: whether ingress-nginx strict-validate-path-type is enabled (default on in >=1.12.0) and ingress-nginx is used for HTTP01 solving

consequence.statement: With ingress-nginx strict-validate-path-type enabled, the admission webhook denies the HTTP01 challenge Ingress (path contains a dot), so presenting the challenge fails and HTTP01 validation does not complete.

assertion.statement: ACME HTTP01 Ingress challenge paths now use PathType Exact, which is rejected by ingress-nginx >=1.8.0 with strict-validate-path-type enabled (default on in >=1.12.0) because the path contains a dot.
